name: LazyCache
plain: A simplified EasyCache wrapped around predict_noise instead of the diffusion model, so it caches the guided result rather than each cond. Its description says it works worse overall but is universal. There is one cache_diff, not one per cond.
math: Same gate as EasyCache on the whole batch: C += R·Δin/‖y_prev‖₁; skip if C<τ. Skip returns x + cache_diff. x uses the first output_channels; y is not cut. Update: cache_diff = y − x.
label: from code
surprise: It wraps predict_noise, whose return (samplers.py:1218) is sampling_function's denoised result, so its stored diff is denoised−x, unlike EasyCache's model output−x.

audit.note: nodes_easycache.py:111,134: only x is cut to output_channels. The output y from executor is used uncut for cache_diff and the stats.
